digest.component_or_area: metrics analyzer dispatch and config schema
propositions: CodeHealthConfig.analyzers field and ANALYZERS registry are never populated in production code, only by test monkeypatching
resolve_analyzer, analyze_or_unavailable, and load_lizard functions have zero production call sites and are dead code
the per-language analyzer dispatch seam was never wired after story 3b30 shipped an intentionally empty registry, bypassed by story 0734 which uses direct composition instead
analyze_or_unavailable would crash at runtime due to a keyword argument mismatch between its caller and scc_loc.analyze parameter names, making the design non-viable
removing the inert config field requires adding tombstone entries to _TOMBSTONE_REGISTRY to warn users with existing configuration rather than silently reverting to default
AnalyzerResult and Analyzer Protocol must be retained as they are imported by git_metrics.py and the live composition path remains unchanged
